title: Restriction of the scalar mate is the specified projection arrow
statement:
Let $f:Z\to T$ be any scheme morphism and $a:A\to B$ any map of commutative ring sheaves on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Put $A_Z=f^{-1}A$, $B_Z=f^{-1}B$ and $a_Z=f^{-1}a$. Use the normalized scalar/tensor identifications $e$ and the source/target identifications [lem-sfb-derived-scalar-tensor-identification], the canonical geometric adjunctions and the balanced inverse-mate scalar/pullback comparison $\lambda$. Let $T_T,T_Z$ denote derived scalar extension and $r_T,r_Z$ restriction. Define $\beta:T_TRf_{*,A}\to Rf_{*,B}T_Z$ to be the geometric mate of $\lambda$. For every pair $t,z$ of the prescribed tensor presentations and every $K\in D(A_Z)$,
$$(\mathrm{targetIso})_K\circ r_T(\beta_K)\circ(\mathrm{sourceIso})_K^{-1}=\pi_{K,r_TB},$$
where $\pi$ is the canonical projection-formula mate [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map] and targetIso includes the specified pullback identification of the coefficient. No flatness or boundedness hypothesis is imposed, and no invertibility of $\pi$ or $\beta$ is asserted.

proof.text: The scalar comparison component followed by extension of the A-geometric counit is q_K. The mateEquiv_counit identity says its B-adjunct is beta_K. Apply proEtaleRingSheafChangeAdjunction to q_K to identify the A-transpose of r_T(beta_K) followed by d with b^{-1} followed by r_Z(q_K). Naturality of e_Z' moves the geometric counit through the tensor identification. Insert the preceding pullback-only identity, cancel U(e_T^{-1}) U(e_T), and recognize mu followed by counit tensor identity as the defining transpose of the projection map. Injectivity of the A-adjunction Hom equivalence yields the asserted equality with sourceIso and targetIso.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarMate_projection_normalization
    {Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ T)
    {A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : A ⟶ B)
    (t : ProEtaleTensorModel T A) (z : ProEtaleTensorModel Z (inverseRing f A)) :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Z (inverseRing f A)),
      (sourceIso f a t).inv.app K ≫
        (restriction a).mapDerivedCategory.map ((beta f a).app K) ≫
        (targetIso f a z).hom.app K =
      proEtaleProjectionFormulaMate f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _) t z K
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (coefficientComplex a)))
